purpose: Provide the authoritative private local and offline catalog, managed-content, classification, provenance, rights, rendition, lifecycle, import, export, backup, and restore service for media, files, instructions, manuals, and accepted learning packages owned by kOA-Linux Operating System.

scope.profile_specific_limits_owner: the active deployment profile and active resource envelope artifacts
scope.implementation_mechanism_owner: the active profile and applicable storage and service toolchains

owns.media_record: Canonical kOA-local identity and metadata for each managed media or file record.
owns.media_version: Version identity, integrity, storage binding, rendition relationships, and lifecycle state for each managed version.
owns.local_content_binding: The authoritative binding between a kOA media version and its managed local content or declared external reference.
owns.classification: Local collections, dimensions, tags, relationships, and classification assertions.
owns.rights_and_restrictions: Locally governed rights, restrictions, consent, cultural conditions, retention, disclosure, and AI-use constraints.
owns.provenance: Source, acquisition, creator, custodian, transformation, validation, and lineage records owned by the local Mediatheque.
owns.rendition_state: Derivation relationships and acceptance state for thumbnails, previews, normalized media, transcripts, and other renditions.
owns.import_export_history: Import requests, quarantine state, local acceptance decisions, export packages, publication requests, UCKK package and receipt references, and update-candidate state.
owns.backup_restore_state: Mediatheque-specific backup manifests, restore checkpoints, and verification results.

does_not_own.fact: UCKK Moodle courses, modules, repositories, records, users, permissions, and UCKK Mediatheque state
authorization to disclose or publish across an authority boundary
external UCKK transport, destination mapping, and remote publication result
identity, role, delegation, trust, and signer authority
policy, consent, disclosure, cultural-rights, and exception decisions
host storage implementation, mounts, encryption mechanism, and physical topology
does_not_own.owner_ref: the active deployment profile and storage toolchain

does_not_own.fact: UCKK import transport, remote source discovery, package retrieval, and quarantine transport state

responsibilities: Create and maintain stable local media-record and media-version identities.
Bind accepted versions to managed local content or explicit external references.
Verify content hashes before accepting or activating a version.
Maintain collections, dimensions, tags, relationships, provenance, rights, restrictions, and lifecycle state.
Generate bounded deterministic renditions through Resource Governor-controlled jobs.
Detect exact duplicates by verified content hash without silently merging distinct records or authority contexts.
Support local search and browsing without requiring UCKK, Internet access, or external AI.
Prepare governed export candidates without granting publication authority.
Preserve publication package and receipt references without making the external destination authoritative over the local source record.
Participate in backup, restore, portability, and credible-exit procedures.
Expose health, queue, storage-pressure, and integrity state without disclosing restricted media content.
Accept validated UCKK learning packages only after quarantine, source, license, integrity, provenance, compatibility, and local-acceptance checks succeed.
Create separate local identities for imported UCKK resources while preserving source and version provenance.
Keep accepted courses, learning paths, manuals, and instructions available for offline consultation within the active profile.
Treat later UCKK versions as explicit update candidates rather than automatic overwrites.
non_responsibilities: Operating or administering UCKK or any Moodle instance.
Owning the UCKK Mediatheque or its remote records.
Performing background bidirectional synchronization with UCKK.
Publishing content without an approved Publication Gateway decision.
Treating a successful UCKK publication as transfer of local source authority.
Inventing rights, consent, provenance, classification, or semantic truth from AI output.
Allowing XLSX, a search index, a generated catalog, or an external service to become the authoritative store.
Writing directly into another component or external platform database.
Automatically importing the public UCKK catalog.
Treating UCKK source identity, metadata, or policy as local authority.
Uploading local progress, private adaptations, or local content merely because connectivity returns.

authority_boundary.local_source_authority: The kOA Mediatheque remains authoritative for its local records and managed versions.
authority_boundary.external_destination_authority: UCKK remains authoritative for records created inside the external Moodle platform.
authority_boundary.compatibility_rule: Both Mediatheques conform to the declared shared Mediatheque frame for interchange; frame compatibility never creates shared storage, identity, access control, lifecycle, or authority.
authority_boundary.publication_rule: Publication creates a governed external representation and receipt; it does not merge the source and destination Mediatheques.
authority_boundary.import_rule: UCKK-to-kOA import uses the separate UCKK Import integration. Retrieval and quarantine precede an explicit local acceptance decision; accepted copies receive local identities and preserve UCKK provenance.

identity_rules: Record identity is stable across versions.
Version identity changes when accepted content or canonical metadata changes according to the active versioning policy.
A content hash identifies bytes and does not alone identify a record, rights context, or semantic object.
External UCKK identifiers are destination references and never replace local record or version identifiers.

user_lightweight_baseline.integrity: SHA-256 or a stronger profile-approved digest

authoritative_store_rules: The authoritative structured store and managed-content root are component-owned.
Search indexes, thumbnails, previews, caches, spreadsheets, and publication packages are rebuildable projections or exchange artifacts.
Database and content backup checkpoints must be coordinated to preserve referential integrity.
Secrets and remote UCKK credentials are not stored in media records.

inbound.role: Attach an external publication result to the local export history without changing source authority.

outbound.role: Produce a verified component backup or portability package under active backup and disclosure policy.

forbidden_transition_rules: A denied publication cannot become submitted without a new authorization decision.
An external publication result cannot change a withdrawn local source record back to active.
Deletion does not falsify historical receipts or remote publication history.

uckk_publication: resolve rights, restrictions, consent, and destination eligibility
build a versioned UCKK publication package
queue or transmit through the UCKK publication integration
attach the receipt to local export history
backup_restore: quiesce or checkpoint the structured store
bind the content manifest to the database checkpoint

offline_model.local_content_available: when the accepted content is stored locally and not restricted by active policy
offline_model.offline_publication_behavior: Authorized packages may be queued locally with visible state and expiry; no success is recorded until an authenticated remote receipt is validated.
offline_model.reconnection_behavior: Retry uses the same package identity and idempotency key unless the authorization, content version, rights, destination, or package has changed.

security_and_privacy.content_disclosure_default: deny unless allowed by record policy and active publication authorization
security_and_privacy.audit_policy: Record identity, action, policy, outcome, and evidence references while minimizing disclosed content.

resource_model.interactive_priority: Catalog browsing, playback of local accepted content, rights checks, and record edits take precedence over background derivation and publication.
resource_model.pressure_behavior: Pause or defer optional derivation and publication work before affecting interactive, policy, identity, audit, or recovery capabilities.

observability_and_operations.support_bundle_rule: Diagnostics must not include media content or restricted metadata unless separately authorized.

interactions.purpose: Submit bounded publication requests and receive authorization outcomes.
Publish an authorized package to the external UCKK Moodle platform.
Admit and bound background media work.
Preserve selective evidence for critical transitions.

required_claims: local authority remains independent from UCKK
offline local operation does not require UCKK
content integrity is verified before acceptance
external publication results are attached as receipts rather than imported as local authority
backup and restore preserve database-content consistency
prohibited_claims: UCKK is an internal kOA-Linux subsystem
the kOA Mediatheque is native to UCKK
a shared conceptual frame implies shared storage or authority
a remote UCKK identifier replaces the local record identifier

minimum_tests: rejection of direct UCKK database access
